title: epipactis purpurata subsp. pollinensis
intro: Epipactis purpurata subsp. pollinensis, commonly known as the Purple Helleborine, is a rare subspecies of orchid found in Europe and Asia. The Purple Helleborine is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Epipactis purpurata subsp. pollinensis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of the Purple Helleborine include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
